import networkx as nx

# Create the Harary graph H_{4,11}
G = nx.Graph()
n = 11
k = 4

# Add vertices
G.add_nodes_from(range(n))

# Add edges: each vertex i connects to i±1, i±2 (mod n)
for i in range(n):
    for j in [1, 2]:
        G.add_edge(i, (i + j) % n)
        G.add_edge(i, (i - j) % n)

# Check vertex connectivity
print(f"Number of vertices: {G.number_of_nodes()}")
print(f"Number of edges: {G.number_of_edges()}")
print(f"Minimum degree: {min(dict(G.degree()).values())}")

# Calculate vertex connectivity
try:
    conn = nx.node_connectivity(G)
    print(f"Vertex connectivity: {conn}")
except Exception as e:
